name: dream-ball
effect: Can only be used in Entree Forest, to catch Pokémon encountered in the Dream World. Used in battle : Catches a wild Pokémon without fail.
shortEffect: Catches Pokémon found in the Dream World.

flavorTextEntries.text: A special Poké Ball that appears out of nowhere in a bag at the Entree Forest. It can catch any Pokémon.
A special Poké Ball that appears in your Bag out of nowhere in the Entree Forest. It can catch any Pokémon.
A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon while they’re asleep.
